items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Well I used to work with Howard and them, sometimes after that job went under, with Abbie and Howard and Morgan

ctx.x: And what about Magazine Street and Chappatoulas, was there anything over that way in my childhood?

Well I used to work with Howard and them, sometimes after that job went under, with Abbie and Howard and Morgan, up at the line in Chappatoulas, and then later they built a place out near the river where I had left. Gee that's pretty near the river, Chappatoulas.
